prompt: [INST] Identify the most pressing global health challenge facing us today. [/INST]
response: One of the most pressing global health challenges facing us today is the COVID-19 pandemic. It has affected millions of people worldwide and has disrupted healthcare systems, economies and societies. In addition to this, there are ongoing challenges such as the rise in non-communicable diseases, antimicrobial resistance, and limited access to healthcare and medicines in many parts of the world. These challenges require global cooperation and concerted efforts from governments, international organizations, and individuals to address them.
